cohorts.name: Joueurs UCKK
cohorts.description: Learners enrolled in the UCKK campus.
cohorts.notes: Pedagogical learner cohort. Symbolic titles such as Joueur lucide are handled through badges, profile fields, competencies, and portfolio distinctions.

cohorts.name: Mentors UCKK
cohorts.description: Teachers, facilitators, challenge evaluators, and assembly guides.
cohorts.notes: Mentors teach courses, evaluate proof, guide challenge workflows, and facilitate assemblies where assigned.

cohorts.name: Archivistes UCKK
cohorts.description: Archive validators, provenance reviewers, and versioning stewards.
cohorts.notes: Archivistes validate archive items, review provenance, manage versions, and handle restricted archive visibility where permitted.

cohorts.name: Inquisiteurs UCKK
cohorts.description: Restricted ethical and methodological reviewers for integrity cases.
cohorts.notes: The Inquisiteur is a guardrail, not a global administrator. Membership must remain restricted, auditable, and contestable.

cohorts.name: Gestionnaires UCKK
cohorts.description: Campus managers responsible for UCKK configuration, reports, seed execution, and institutional oversight.
cohorts.notes: Gestionnaires manage UCKK configuration and reporting, but symbolic titles remain outside the Moodle role system.

cohorts.name: Observateurs UCKK
cohorts.description: Restricted read-only participants.
cohorts.notes: Observateurs can view only content explicitly exposed to them by capability and visibility rules.

cohorts.name: Invités publics limités
cohorts.description: Public-facing read-only guests where public visibility is explicitly enabled.
cohorts.notes: This cohort must never bypass archive, integrity, privacy, or course visibility constraints.

cohorts.name: Tronc commun obligatoire
cohorts.description: Learners taking the mandatory UCKK tronc commun sequence.
cohorts.notes: Used for TC101–TC108 progress, competency, badge, and pathway reporting.

cohorts.name: Orientation UCKK
cohorts.description: Participants enrolled in the UCKK orientation course.
cohorts.notes: Entry cohort for the UCKK-Moodle campus.
